title: Electrolytic cement clinker precursor production sustained through orthogonalization of ion vectors
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04881D, Paper
Zishuai Zhang, Aubry S. R. Williams, Shaoxuan Ren, Benjamin A. W. Mowbray, Colin T. E. Parkyn, Yongwook Kim, Tengxiao Ji, Curtis P. Berlinguette
An electrochemical reactor (“cement electrolyser”) in tandem with a chemical reactor (“calcium reactor”) enables electrochemical production of Ca(OH)2 for 50 hours at 100 mA cm−2.
